description.value: Champions Guild Automation: Pull of Death: once per turn, when your spell or attack damages a single creature that's missing Hit Points, the module adds 1d4 Necrotic (1d6 at Cleric level 11). Return to Life: cast Spare the Dying as a Bonus Action (by hand). Healing dice of your spells and Channel Divinity are maximized on a creature at 0 Hit Points (module).

automation.notes: Champions Guild Automation: Pull of Death extra Necrotic and maximized healing on creatures at 0 HP (module).
